title: Fit one Shield Booster II into a free defence slot of a Pulse Laser III ship at Ironlight Crossroads, LHS 1140: one ship first
note: Written by Apophis 2026-11-22 16:11 UTC (orders ENT-064, block APOPHIS: weapons and armour fitted; rule F17: a new module on one ship first; F37: the first alone, two more follow). Why: three Pulse Laser III ships kill a pilot whale at full hull, one alone does not pass the toughness gauge (gauges.py species: pilot_whale needs a side of 3); a Shield Booster II (cpu 3, power 6, catalog 0.732.3) is the next defence step. Asks read 15:56 UTC: 7,506 cr x 20 at Ironlight Crossroads (table books), 8,069 x 1 at Central Nexus. No replace: a Threshold has 2 defence slots and the PL3 ships without a Shield Booster I have both free. Paid from the pilot's own wallet (F12; min_credits 30,000 keeps it above F7). Its test hunt: hunt-test-siphon-pilot-whale-sb2. 2026-11-22 16:24 UTC (Apophis): min_credits 30,000 -> 15,000: the sweep leaves a drone at most 30,000 cr (rule F7), so the gate stood closed to all three pilots named for it (wallets 29,384, 23,123 and 12,931 cr, ship files); 15,000 less the 7,581 of the buy still leaves the pilot above the floor of 3,000 and the top-up line of 10,000 after the top-up. 2026-11-22 16:53 UTC (Apophis): the first fit stood alone (F17): bought at 7,506 and fitted at 16:37 UTC (run log, -7,581 cr); the shield of that ship rose from 80 to 130 (ship file). Its first test hunt killed a pilot whale alone at 16:52 UTC, hull 75 of 75, shield down to 17 percent (run log). max_pilots 1 -> 3: two more follow (F37), each from its own wallet. 2026-11-22 20:21 UTC (Apophis): proven by F37: its test hunt killed a pilot whale alone in 8 of 9 runs by two ships, the lowest hull 97 to 100 percent (runs.jsonl). Lifted for every Pulse Laser III ship with a free defence slot: max_ships 1 -> 3, max_pilots 3 -> 19 (asks 20 at 7,506 at Ironlight Crossroads at 15:29 UTC, three taken); each pays from its own wallet (F12); in the list First.
